> Return a Random Series

```{ojs}
viewof recalc = Inputs.button("Get")

viewof n = Inputs.select
            (d3.range(0, 21, 5), 
              {label: "Length:",
              value: 5}
            )
            
```

```{ojs}
/**
 * Strict Uniform Float in [0, 1) using 53 bits of cryptographically pure entropy.
 * Matches IEEE-754 double precision limit without uniform density loss.
 */
function getStrictUniformFloat() {
  const buffer = new Uint32Array(2);
  crypto.getRandomValues(buffer);

  // Extract 53 random bits (53-bit mantissa precision for JS numbers)
  const high = buffer[0] & 0x1FFFFF; // 21 bits
  const low = buffer[1];             // 32 bits

  const combined53BitInt = (high * 0x100000000) + low;

  // Divide by 2^53 (9007199254740992)
  return combined53BitInt / 9007199254740992;
}

side = {

  recalc;
  
  const iteration = !n ? 1 : n; 
  console.log(iteration);
  
  let randomNumbers = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < iteration; i++) {
    randomNumbers.push(Number((getStrictUniformFloat()*150).toFixed(0)));
  }

  console.log(randomNumbers);
  return JSON.stringify(randomNumbers, null, 2);
}

side
```
